t: A tiny low-power LoRa radio board for off-grid Meshtastic messages.
steps: Buy the T114 V2 or later from the Heltec store or a reseller. Pick the band for your country and decide on the screen and GPS options.
Screw the LoRa antenna onto its connector before you power it up.
Plug the board into a computer with a USB-C cable.
Double-press reset to mount it as a drive and drag on the Meshtastic firmware file.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Set your region in the app to match local radio rules.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE with the Heltec nRF52 board package and try a blink example.
meta: Open Board. From $32.97. A few stores.
